Worst experience in Vietnam
May 2025 • Couples
We ordered a hot pot dish at the restaurant, and oh boy — that’s when the show began. They brought the cooker to the table but completely struggled to make it work. After a while, the pot finally started boiling, and they brought over the ingredients, placed everything on the table, and... just left. Apparently, we were expected to cook everything ourselves — but no one gave us any instructions.

We eventually convinced the waiter that we had no idea what to do, so after some time, someone came over to help us.

And then came the final straw: we had ordered goat meat but were served chicken instead. When we pointed it out to the waiter, she simply said “sorry” (probably for the hundredth time that evening) and seemed completely ready to leave it at that. Only after we made it clear that we weren’t going to eat chicken did she agree to bring the goat meat.

All in all, it took more than an hour just to get a proper meal.
